title: Crawling From the Wreckage
summary: When we wrote yesterday’s piece, stocks were already off to a very negative start. Things got no better as the day progressed. Both the S&P 500 (SPX) and Nasdaq 100 (NDX) closed near their lows of -4.4% and -6.4%, respectively. VIX closed near its high as well. The selling never relented, and the few serious attempts by dip buyers were snuffed out relatively quickly. This morning we see legitimate bargain hunting. The gains are solid but far from sufficient to recoup yesterday’s damage.
